title: Obey Giant website
lede: Shepard Fairey’s studio site opens with a full red panel of white condensed capitals beside a black-and-white photograph of one of his murals.
summary: A red half-screen with the slogan in white condensed capitals, a black navigation bar, and a desaturated street photograph.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. Nothing covers the first viewport. The measurement covers up to four screens.

styles.note: Borderline: a contemporary propaganda aesthetic that Wikipedia traces to Russian Constructivism. The hero has the red field, white capitals, and black-and-white photograph, but no diagonal, and the featured mural brings in several hues.

context: Wikipedia states that Fairey “began appropriating the Russian Constructivist style utilized in Soviet-era propaganda during his time in San Diego”. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shepard_Fairey).
observed: The left half of the first viewport is a solid red panel. It carries “MANUFACTURING QUALITY DISSENT SINCE 1989” in large white condensed capitals, a small kicker in the same face, and a white outlined button “READ LATEST NEWS”.
The right half is a black-and-white photograph of a building, looking up at a steep angle, with a colored mural that reads “PEACE”. Only the mural is in color.
A dark bar across the top holds the star logo in a circle and the navigation in small gray condensed capitals.
Corners are square. There are no shadows except a dark overlay on the navigation bar.
interpretation: The site passes five of seven fingerprint metrics: one hue, 19% chromatic area, 38% uppercase text, square corners, and few shadows. It fails `type.headingWeight` because the condensed display face (Knockout) is set at weight 400, although it reads as heavy, and `color.gradientShare` (0.08) because of the overlay on the photograph.
The upward view of the building echoes the steep camera angles of Rodchenko’s photography, but the page itself stays orthogonal.
borrow: Split the first screen into a solid red text panel and a black-and-white photograph.
Set a two-line slogan in condensed capitals and a single outlined button, with nothing else in the panel.

images.alt: Obey Giant home page: a solid red left half with the slogan Manufacturing Quality Dissent Since 1989 in white condensed capitals and an outlined button, and on the right a black-and-white upward view of a building with a colorful Peace mural.
images.caption: First viewport of [obeygiant.com](https://obeygiant.com/), captured 28 September 2026.
